pending_interview.question: You are asked to design a notification delivery system for a large consumer platform — think on the scale of a major social network or e-commerce site. The system needs to send notifications across multiple channels: push notifications to mobile devices, emails, and in-app alerts. At peak times, the system may need to handle tens of millions of notifications per hour. Walk through how you would design this system: the major components, how you would handle scale and reliability, what happens when a downstream channel (like an email provider) goes down, and how you would ensure that a user does not receive the same notification twice. You do not need to write code — reason through the architecture.
